generalTips: Always carry light cotton clothing for coastal & plains travel, and heavy woollens for high-altitude regions like Kashmir & Ladakh.
Stay hydrated with bottled coconut water or filtered water while exploring heritage forts.
Keep emergency medicines, power banks, and Offline Google Maps downloaded before heading to mountain passes.

seasonalAdvice.winter: October to March is ideal for Rajasthan, Goa, Kerala, and Andaman. Heavy snowfall in Manali, Gulmarg, and Ladakh.
seasonalAdvice.summer: April to June is the peak season for hill stations like Shimla, Manali, Munnar, Rishikesh, and high passes in Leh Ladakh.
seasonalAdvice.monsoon: July to September brings breathtaking greenery to Western Ghats in Kerala & Goa. Avoid heavy trekking paths in landslides zones.
